fn base_s() -> i64 {
    std::time::SystemTime::now()
        .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
        .expect("clock")
        .as_secs() as i64
}

fn past_window(width_s: i64) -> (i64, i64) {
    let now_s = std::time::SystemTime::now()
        .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
        .expect("clock")
        .as_secs() as i64;
    (now_s - 60 - width_s, now_s - 60)
}

fn a_case() -> (i64, i64) {
    let now_s = std::time::SystemTime::now()
        .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
        .expect("clock")
        .as_secs() as i64;
    (now_s - 5, now_s)
}
